MARGE KAECHLE Obituary
KAECHLE MARGE McCALLUM of Beverly Hills, Michigan, and Siesta Key, Florida, passed away on June 25, 2012. Marge is survived by her beloved daughter Karen Lavens (Bob), son Bill Kaechle (Cheryl), her grandchildren Muffy Lavens and Zach and Alex Kaechle, sister-in-law Sue McCallum, and nephews John, Ken and Dan McCallum. Marge was preceded in death by her husband, Clarence Kaechle and her brother, John McCallum. Marge was a jewelry designer and active in local art circles. She was a graduate of Siena Heights University. Marge pursued her passion for art and culture as she traveled the world, circumnavigating the globe and visiting all seven continents. She was a member of the Creative Council and of Christ-Church Cranbrook. A celebration of life will be held at a future date. Donations may be made to the Salvation Army or the Michigan Humane Society.

Published by The Detroit News on Jul. 8, 2012. (https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/detroitnews/name/marge-kaechle-obituary?id=42444924)
